test_title: PYST 09: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 09 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What special status did the Sixty-ninth Amendment Act, 1991 give to Delhi?

options.text: Designated Delhi as the National Capital Territory with a legislative assembly
Brought Delhi under the control of the President through the Governor
Made Delhi a Union Territory without a legislature

solution:
The Correct answer is __**Designated Delhi as the National Capital Territory with a legislative assembly**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Sixty-ninth Amendment Act, 1991** granted Delhi the status of a **National Capital Territory (NCT).**
 
• This amendment enabled Delhi to have its own **legislative assembly** and **Council of Ministers** to manage affairs related to certain subjects.
 
• It introduced **Article 239AA** into the Constitution of India, detailing the structure and functioning of the governance in Delhi.
 
• While Delhi was given a legislative assembly, it remained a **Union Territory**, with its legislative powers limited to specific domains like public order, police, and land under the control of the Union Government.
 
• Delhi's governance is unique as it has a blend of both the **Union Government** and a locally elected assembly, making it distinct from full-fledged states.
 
• The amendment aimed to strike a balance between Delhi's status as the **capital city** and granting it some degree of self-governance.
 
• The Chief Minister of Delhi is the head of the elected government, but the **Lieutenant Governor** retains significant powers and represents the Union Government.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Brought Delhi under the control of the President through the Governor**__

 __
 
• Delhi is governed by the **Lieutenant Governor**, who acts as the representative of the President of India, but it is not directly under the control of a Governor as seen in states.
 
• The **Lieutenant Governor** holds administrative authority and works alongside the elected government.
 
 
 
• **Granted full Statehood to Delhi**__
 __
 
• Delhi has not been granted full statehood. It remains a **Union Territory** with partial state-like governance powers.
 
• Matters like **public order, police, and land** are still under the control of the Union Government.
 
 
 
• **Made Delhi a Union Territory without a legislature**__
 
 
• This option is incorrect because the **Sixty-ninth Amendment Act** explicitly provided Delhi with a **legislative assembly** to handle certain subjects.
 
• Delhi's governance model is distinct from a typical Union Territory without legislative powers, such as Chandigarh.
